scope: One exposed HSP90 development CaseGraph and one SOURCE target. This is not a new PR1B phase, generic scheduler, or globally active Rules-v1 sub-rule.

runtime_subrule.scientific_question: For a declared MD source making only a same-packet two-readout directional-block claim, is a case-bound trajectory-level time-semantics and persistence-control evidence record available?
runtime_subrule.claim_effect_summary: A PASS establishes only that the frozen same-packet diagnostic has a validated control record. It never establishes convergence, a transition rate, equilibrium, population, free energy, mechanism, or mutation effect.

pass_conditions: A fresh, exact-case-bound EvidenceResult has contract_status PASS, references this RuleInstance, and has scientific_evaluation_status PENDING_HUMAN_VALIDATION.
fail_conditions: A fresh, exact-case-bound EvidenceResult for this RuleInstance has contract_status FAIL because its manifest, parameters, cohort, or output contract did not validate.
unresolved_conditions: No exact-case-bound EvidenceResult is available for this RuleInstance.
The selected Operator is not ROSTER_PASS/routable, does not match the declared capability/profile/manifest, or does not produce a valid receipt.

PASS.claim_ceiling: The frozen same-packet diagnostic has a validated trajectory-level control record; no broader scientific verdict is emitted.

FAIL.claim_ceiling: The requested same-packet diagnostic cannot support its declared control contract until a human resolves the manifest, parameter, cohort, or output failure.

UNRESOLVED.claim_ceiling: A computable control record is missing; no directional, kinetic, equilibrium, or mechanistic inference is emitted.

NOT_APPLICABLE.claim_ceiling: This source does not declare the exact MD directional-time-anatomy question.

resolution_policy.purpose: Resolve the one HSP90 trajectory-level directional-time-anatomy control gap through an exact case-bound registered Operator or a human/new-data stop.
operator_route_conditions: The RuleInstance must be UNRESOLVED with COMPUTABLE_TIME_ANATOMY_CONTROL_EVIDENCE_MISSING.
The Operator must be ROSTER_PASS and routable.
The capability, source method profile, case ID, source ID, RuleInstance ID, fixed input manifest, and frozen output contract must match exactly.
